sectionContent.heading: What happens when expense management finally works?
sectionContent.subheading: Six outcomes your finance team feels from day one — measurable, real, and compounding.

cta.eyebrow: The bigger your business becomes, the more expensive these inefficiencies get.
cta.body: Every untracked rupee compounds. Act before it compounds further.

cards.title: Complete spend visibility
cards.description: Know exactly where every rupee flows across every team, office, and department — in real time.

cards.title: Close books faster
cards.description: Slash month-end reconciliation time. Finance closes in days, not weeks.

cards.title: Scale without complexity
cards.description: Multiple teams, offices, and departments — one unified platform. No added overhead as you grow.

cards.title: Improve profitability
cards.description: Catch overspending patterns before they erode margins. Act on data, not gut feel. Every department stays inside budget with policy enforcement baked in at the point of spend.

cards.title: Eliminate reimbursement delays
cards.description: Automated reimbursements keep employees paid on time — no lengthy nudges required.

cards.title: Reduce financial leakage
cards.description: Auto-flag duplicates, unauthorized spends, and policy violations before payout. Zero leakage.
